signature: SUBROUTINE DRSCL( N, SA, SX, INCX )

params.name: N
params.reference: The number of components of the vector x.

params.name: sa
params.reference: The scalar a which is used to divide each component of x. `SA` must be \>= 0, or the subroutine will divide by zero.

params.name: incx
params.reference:
The increment between successive values of the vector `SX`.

-   `> 0`: `SX(1) = X(1)` and `SX(1+(i-1)*INCX) = x(i)`,     $1< i \le n$
